tracks.title: Ignition: The Forger's Call
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: The official October 1986 Crucible Stadium Master played over the PA towers at every CPI Forgers home football game as the football team charges out of the tunnel onto the field—released on an album for the very first time in October 2016 alongside *Live at the Crucible*. Replacing the garage demo's vocalized `(TING... BOOM!)` placeholders with a real steel foundry anvil strike and Tyler Wright's chest-rattling **`82 BPM`** kick-drum groove, this is the exact recording to which the student section in **The Anvil** organically crafted **The Stomp** over several successive home games inside **The Crucible**.

tracks.title: This Side of Heaven
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in September 1988 between *Electric Color* (1987) and *Neon Hearts* (1989) as a sunlit **`126 BPM`** 1980s synth-rock anthem celebrating freshman move-in week at **Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute (CPI)**—and intentionally withheld from Apex Records so the label could never commercialize a deeply personal song about Blacksburg sanctuary. Distributed on campus cassettes at the **CPI Campus Bookstore**, it became the generational move-in anthem for CPI freshmen (and the song playing on Jordan Sinclair's phone in January 2015 in *The Eleventh Child: The Story of Jordan*, Episode 3, Chapter 1 when he realizes his mother's oppression is behind him, he is surrounded by people who love him, and CPI truly is *This Side of Heaven*).

tracks.title: Kerosene & 4-Track Tape
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Tracked in late October 1986 inside the unheated two-car garage on **Progress Street** on the reverse side of the same Maxell XLII-S 90 cassette that held `Demo Take 3` of *"Ignition: The Forger's Call"*. Powered by a roaring portable kerosene space heater between takes, this raw **`138 BPM`** four-piece garage rocker captures 22-year-old Ryan O'Connell, Cassidy O'Connell, Evan Wright, and Tyler Wright celebrating their first autumn together as a family band in Blacksburg before Apex Records ever heard their name.

tracks.title: The Anvil: 126.2 Decibels
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in November 1989 for the **The Crucible** stadium PA booth after the North End Zone student section (**The Anvil**) registered a historic **`126.2 dBA`** peak and triggered a seismic tremor on the **Copernicus Hall** Department of Geosciences seismograph during a goal-line stand. Built around an **`84 BPM`** stomping kick-drum and foundry-brass groove by Tyler, Evan, Ryan, and Cassidy, it has served as CPI's official 3rd-down defensive timeout cue for over a quarter century.

tracks.title: Snowfall on Commonwealth Green
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in January 1990 on Progress Street during a quiet winter break in Blacksburg—eleven months before the December 1990 I-81 tour bus crash changed the family's lives forever. Featuring Ryan on 12-string acoustic guitar and Cassidy on warm analog chorus synthesizer pads and grand piano, this **`92 BPM`** winter ballad paints the hush of fresh mountain snow blanketing **Commonwealth Green**, the gothic **Ironstone** towers of **Pendleton Library** and **Preston Hall**, and the footprints of students walking home together under the amber campus lamps.

tracks.title: Under the Keystone Bridge
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in November 1991 in Blacksburg during Ryan O'Connell's first autumn back home as a T10 paraplegic wheelchair user following the December 1990 I-81 crash. Named after **The Keystone Bridge**—the iconic gothic **Ironstone** skybridge spanning **Commonwealth Mall** at the main entrance to campus—this **`124 BPM`** heartland synth-rock song celebrates rolling through the arches of CPI with Cassidy, Holly, Evan, and Tyler at his side and realizing that home still belongs to him.

tracks.title: One Dollar on the Kitchen Table
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Tracked in July 1992 in the Progress Street living room on the night 22-year-old **Holly O'Connell** incorporated *Engine Room Records, LLC* in preparation for the band's walkout from Apex Records. A joyous **`132 BPM`** melodic arena-rock tribute to Holly's October 1986 **`$1.00` Perpetual Mutual Cross-License** ('The Progress Street Redline'), celebrating how a sixteen-year-old girl with a red ballpoint pen and a single dollar bill taped inside the kitchen ledger saved the family's masters before their career even began.

tracks.title: Copernicus Hall: Roof of the World
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in April 1994 immediately after Holly O'Connell secured the legal emancipation of the band's master tapes from Apex Records. Inspired by late-night stargazing from the rooftop astronomy dome of **Copernicus Hall** overlooking **Commonwealth Green**, this **`108 BPM`** instrumental duet between Cassidy's sweeping polyphonic and monophonic analog synthesizers and Ryan's soaring electric guitar bridges the gap between 1986's *"The Stardust Engine"* and 1996's *"Escape Velocity (Ad Astra)"*.

tracks.title: Foundry Maroon & Molten Orange
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in October 1996 to celebrate the 10th Anniversary of *"Ignition: The Forger's Call"* and pressed as a limited Homecoming cassette for students dining at **The Foundry** and packing **The Crucible**. An exuberant **`130 BPM`** 1980s-style stadium rock duet between Ryan and Cassidy celebrating CPI's official school colors—**Foundry Maroon** (`#861F41`) and **Molten Orange** (`#E5751F`)—lighting up the New River Valley every autumn Saturday.

tracks.title: The Old Lady on the Hill
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Tracked in September 1998 during an autumn afternoon visit to **Bennett Hall**—CPI's oldest surviving red-brick academic building (constructed in 1882), affectionately known to generations of CPI students and alumni as **"The Old Lady on the Hill"**. Built around warm **`112 BPM`** acoustic guitars, mandolin-voiced 12-string, tonewheel organ, and sibling harmonies, the song honors the creaking heart-pine floors and quiet resilience of the hilltop landmark where Cassidy and Ryan attended their very first freshman humanities seminars.

tracks.title: Cadence in The Furnace
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in February 2000 with **Tyler Wright** on acoustic kit and Kevlar marching snare alongside student percussionists from **The Engine Room** (the drumline of the CPI Marching Forgers) for CPI's 10,000-seat parabolic-arch basketball and convocation arena, **The Furnace**. A blistering **`120 BPM`** percussion, slap-bass, and dual-guitar showcase engineered to echo off the steepest acoustic bowl in college basketball.

tracks.title: Ironstone & Starlight
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: An unreleased August 2004 studio outtake from the *Progress Street* sessions in Blacksburg, held back only because *Progress Street* had already reached its 13-track narrative arc ending with *"Last Bus Home: Lights Out on Progress Street"*. A soaring **`118 BPM`** 1980s AOR duet contrasting the terrestrial permanence of CPI's gray-and-pink dolomitic limestone (**Ironstone**) with the infinite **Starlight** above the Blue Ridge Mountains.

tracks.title: Walk-On: Tunnel to the Crucible
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded quietly in Blacksburg in August 2006—two years into the band's Burnout Hiatus—as a gift to the CPI Athletic Department for the 20th Anniversary of *"Ignition: The Forger's Call"*. This **`142 BPM`** locker-room hard-rock charger tells the story of an overlooked, unrecruited walk-on player taping his wrists beneath the concrete tunnel of **The Crucible**, proving that at a polytechnic school built by Forgers, heart and grit outwork pedigree every Saturday night.

tracks.title: Living Room Reignition
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Captured live on a single stereo condenser pair in the Progress Street living room in November 2012—eight years into the Burnout Hiatus—the night Ryan, Cassidy, Evan, and Tyler plugged in all four instruments together for the first time since 2005's *Live in Norfolk*. Raw, unpolished, and overflowing with joy at **`116 BPM`**, this rehearsal tape is the exact spark that led to 2015's *Reignition* and the 2016 return to **The Crucible**.

tracks.title: Ad Astra, Per Aspera: Hymn for the Crucible
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded in May 2016 inside **Callahan Hall** on the CPI campus with the brass choir of the **CPI Marching Forgers** right before the May 21, 2016 *Live at the Crucible* concert. A majestic **`78 BPM`** rock-and-brass alma mater benediction ("Through Hardship to the Stars") sung by Cassidy and Ryan with full collegiate brass harmonies, honoring thirty years of brotherhood, sisterhood, and sanctuary before Track 16 takes the listener all the way back to the October 1986 Progress Street garage cassette where the journey began.

tracks.title: Ignition: The Forger's Call
tracks.discName: The Forger's Call: 30th-Anniversary CPI & Blacksburg Archival Compilation (1986–2016)
tracks.loreNote: Closing the 30th-Anniversary anthology right where the story began: the legendary October 1986 4-track Tascam Portastudio cassette recording (`Demo Take 3`) tracked inside the unheated garage on Progress Street in Blacksburg, Virginia, and submitted by Ryan O'Connell, Cassidy O'Connell, Evan Wright, Tyler Wright, and 16-year-old dual-enrolled Holly O'Connell to the CPI Student Government Association stadium anthem contest. Protected by Holly's historic **`$1.00` Perpetual Mutual Cross-License** ('The Progress Street Redline'), this raw cassette cut captures the mechanical click of the 4-track tape deck, 22-year-old Ryan's spoken garage slate, and the band members vocalizing `(TING... BOOM!)` on the tape to test the idea of where the foundry anvil strikes.
